{{< include _biomarker_data.qmd >}}

```{r}
#| label: biomarkers-ancova-interaction-unadjusted
#| include: false

# add age_group to biomarker_data for age-stratified interaction
biomarker_data <- biomarker_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    age_group = dplyr::case_when(
      demo_age < 12 ~ "Age 6-11",
      demo_age >= 12 ~ "Age 12+"
    ) |>
      factor(levels = c("Age 6-11", "Age 12+"))
  )

biomarker_var <- c(
  "tassone_fmr1_log", "tassone_cyfip1_log", "tassone_mmp9_log", "fmrp_rhmc_log"
)
biomarker_label <- c(
  "log(FMR1)", "log(CYFIP1)", "log(MMP9)", "log[FMRP (relative)]"
)
names(biomarker_label) <- biomarker_var

# fit ANCOVA models with Treatment*strata_var interaction (unadjusted for demographics)
biomarker_ancova_intrxn_unadj <- lapply(
  biomarker_var,
  function(x) fit_ancova_interaction(
    dataset = biomarker_data,
    outcome = x,
    outcome_label = biomarker_label[x],
    demo_vars = NULL,
    covariates = NULL,
    strata_var = strata_var,
    strata_label = strata_label,
    site = FALSE
  )
)
names(biomarker_ancova_intrxn_unadj) <- biomarker_label

# extract tables from fit_ancova_interaction output
biomarker_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  lapply(
    names(biomarker_ancova_intrxn_unadj),
    function(x) {
      biomarker_ancova_intrxn_unadj[[x]]$tbl
    }
  )
)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-biomarkers-ancova-interaction-unadjusted
#| tbl-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "Biomarkers - Unadjusted ANCOVA results with Treatment*{strata_label} interaction showing LS means (95% CI)
#|    for baseline and 16-week change, and between-group difference in changes stratified by {strata_label}
#|    (not adjusted for demographics). {data_caption}")

biomarker_ancova_intrxn_unadj_ft <- biomarker_ancova_intrxn_unadj_summary |>
  dplyr::select(-interaction_p) |>
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::set_header_labels(
    Outcome = "Outcome",
    strata_label = strata_label,
    n_p = "N",
    baseline_p = "Baseline",
    baseline_p_ci = "95% CI",
    week16_p = "Week 16",
    week16_p_ci = "95% CI",
    p_change = "Change",
    p_change_ci = "95% CI",
    n_m = "N",
    baseline_m = "Baseline",
    baseline_m_ci = "95% CI",
    week16_m = "Week 16",
    week16_m_ci = "95% CI",
    m_change = "Change",
    m_change_ci = "95% CI",
    baseline_contrast_mean = "Baseline Diff",
    baseline_contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    contrast_mean = "Change Diff",
    contrast_ci = "95% CI",
    interaction_est = "Interaction Estimate",
    interaction_ci = "95% CI"
  ) |>
  flextable::add_header_row(
    values = c("", "", "Placebo", "Metformin", "Between-Group Differences", ""),
    colwidths = c(1, 1, 7, 7, 4, 2)
  ) |>
  flextable::merge_v(j = c("Outcome", "interaction_est", "interaction_ci")) |>
  flextable::theme_vanilla() |>
  flextable::align(i = 1, align = "left", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(i = 2, align = "center", part = "header") |>
  flextable::align(j = 1:2, align = "left", part = "all") |>
  flextable::align(j = c(21, 22), align = "center", part = "body") |>
  flextable::vline(j = c(2, 9, 16), part = "all") |>
  flextable::autofit()

biomarker_ancova_intrxn_unadj_ft
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-biomarkers-ancova-interaction-unadjusted-forest
#| fig-cap: !expr
#|    glue::glue(
#|    "Biomarkers - Forest plot showing Treatment*{strata_label} interaction term (unadjusted). {data_caption}")

plot_ancova_interaction_forest(
  obj = biomarker_ancova_intrxn_unadj,
  labels = biomarker_label,
  min_mult = 1.1,
  max_mult = 1.1,
  arrow_labs = strata_levels
)
```
